title: European police say Binance's April 2025 policy asking law enforcement to route certain requests to foreign governments significantly delays criminal probes (New York Times)
summary: New York Times: European police say Binance's April 2025 policy asking law enforcement to route certain requests to foreign governments significantly delays criminal probes — Investigators in Europe said that the cryptocurrency giant Binance had made it more difficult to track down scammers and solve other crimes.
